verdict.rationale: Firstbase's pricing page documents its own mail service: a physical business address with 'unlimited incoming mail, scans, recycling' and 'unlimited digital storage,' plus in-app file digitization. That covers scanning mail into an online account, but there is no explicit evidence that registered-agent state notices or legal documents are scanned there, or of in-app reading, downloading, or sharing. Missing for 10: explicit scanning of registered-agent and state legal mail, documented read/download/share functions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
